events.event_name: JSM Beauty × Van Leeuwen Mobile Pop-Up
events.brand: Jung Saem Mool Beauty × Van Leeuwen
events.address: Multiple Manhattan stops: Lexington Avenue; 557 Broadway; 21-27 9th Avenue
events.what_it_is: A two-day mobile K-beauty and ice-cream activation celebrating Jung Saem Mool Beauty's U.S. Sephora launch, with three Manhattan stops each day.
events.what_is_free: A special JSM Beauty × Van Leeuwen ice cream is offered to guests who follow @jsmbeauty_global. Guests who tag the brand and share the activation to Instagram Stories with the stated hashtags can have a chance to receive a full-size Metal Lip Serum; the social giveaway is limited to 200 units per day.
events.caveats: Open to the public. The free ice cream requires following @jsmbeauty_global. The full-size lip-serum promotion requires the stated social post/tag behavior and is limited to 200 units per day. Treat giveaways as while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: The truck moves between three Manhattan locations each day; use the date-specific occurrence details for stop times.

events.what_it_is: Heaven Mayhem's first brick-and-mortar pop-up, featuring the brand's accessories and special opening-weekend activities at Shopify NY.
events.what_is_free: Entry is free. Gift-with-purchase items are advertised from Youth to the People, Summer Fridays and Heaven Mayhem. The first 100 guests on opening day were offered free matcha; that opening-day offer is not carried forward to Sept. 19-20.
events.caveats: Free admission does not mean merchandise or gift-with-purchase offers are free without purchase. The free-matcha offer applied to opening day only.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 19 and Sept. 20 hours are both 11 AM-6 PM at Shopify NY, 131 Greene Street.

events.what_it_is: A free immersive bodega-themed activation from TEMPTATIONS centered on New York's bodega-cat culture.
events.what_is_free: Free product sampling, claw-machine games, scratch-off prize opportunities and branded merchandise are advertised as part of the activation.
events.caveats: Sept. 19 is the final advertised day. Sampling, prizes and merchandise should be treated as subject to availability while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Open Sept. 17-19, noon-6 PM daily. This feed adds only the still-actionable Sept. 19 occurrence.
